title: EXP.DY.-----POL.P.
description: Chart on book p. 514 (MP(II)-32). EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) is the subject; POL-P (political policies) is the partner. From SOC-RT: PART (participation). From PROG-CONT: TRS (transition). From PART: JR-DYM (journalism dynamics). From TRS: CULT-TF-S.
